transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
X has unified Grok, Cursor and X Premium into one subscription with tiered access to artificial intelligence and coding tools, according to Free Press Journal Confirmed.
Anthropic cuts reasoning token theft by 90 to 99 percent to block artificial intelligence model copying, reports The Decoder Confirmed.
Anthropic warns small artificial intelligence models could replicate across devices, with replication possible by end of year, still open per Business Today.
226 delegates from 22 countries discuss artificial intelligence's impact on digital infrastructure and connectivity at a global forum in October 2026, The Joplin Globe Confirmed.
400 scientists urge international oversight for advanced artificial intelligence safety and containment, according to KELO-AM Confirmed.
